slides.title: Case ownership is a testable response to stalled approvals

regions.heading: Illustrative service-team evidence
regions.body:
“I lose time finding who can approve the exception.”
Illustrative respondent, service team; not a real interview.

regions.heading: Action to test
regions.body:
Assign one owner daily.
Escalate unowned cases after 24 hours.

slides.takeaway: Test ownership rules before assuming the change will reduce resolution time.
slides.source: Synthetic case review and invented interview example; October 2026
slides.notes: The invented quote and illustrative review metric motivate a pilot; they do not establish causality or actual benefits.
